Name: [DAX Expressions] Column references should be fully qualified
Description: Always qualify column references as 'Table'[Column] in measures, KPIs, RLS expressions, and calculation items to distinguish columns from measures and avoid context ambiguity.

Name: [DAX Expressions] Measure references should be unqualified
Description: Always reference measures as [Measure] without a table prefix so measures remain clearly distinguishable from columns.

Name: [Error Prevention] Relationship columns should be of the same data type
Description: Columns on both sides of a relationship should share the same data type to avoid join mismatches or conversion overhead.

Name: [Error Prevention] Avoid USERELATIONSHIP and RLS against the same table
Description: Using USERELATIONSHIP on a table that also enforces Row-Level Security causes query errors in Power BI.

Name: [Performance] Avoid many-to-many relationships on tables with dynamic RLS
Description: Many-to-many relationships combined with dynamic Row-Level Security severely degrade query performance.

Name: [Error Prevention] Avoid invalid control characters in object names
Description: Control characters in model object names cause deployment failures.
Scope: Table, Measure, Hierarchy, Level, Perspective, Partition, DataColumn, CalculatedColumn, CalculatedTable, CalculatedTableColumn, KPI, ModelRole, CalculationGroup, CalculationItem

Name: [Error Prevention] Data columns must have a source column
Description: Every physical DataColumn must map to a valid SourceColumn.

Name: [Error Prevention] Expression-reliant objects must have an expression
Description: Measures, calculated columns, and calculation items cannot have blank DAX expressions.

Name: [DAX Expressions] Remove EVALUATEANDLOG from production models
Description: EVALUATEANDLOG is a debug function and should not remain in production semantic models.

Name: [Performance] Model should have a marked Date table
Description: Models should include a Date table marked with DataCategory = Time and a DateTime key column.

Name: [Performance] Date/Calendar tables should be marked as a Date table
Description: Tables named Date or Calendar should be marked as a Date table (DataCategory = Time + DateTime key column).
Expression: (Name.ToUpper().Contains("DATE") or Name.ToUpper().Contains("CALENDAR")) and (DataCategory <> "Time" or Columns.Any(IsKey == true && DataType == "DateTime") == false)

Name: [Performance] Remove auto-date/time hidden tables
Description: Disable Auto Date/Time in Power BI Desktop to eliminate hidden DateTableTemplate and LocalDateTable bloat.

Name: [Performance] Consider a star schema instead of snowflake chains
Description: Tables acting as both FromTable and ToTable in relationships create snowflake chains; evaluate flattening dimensions into a star schema.

Name: [Performance] Avoid excessive bi-directional or many-to-many relationships
Description: Keep bi-directional and many-to-many relationships below 30% of total model relationships to prevent ambiguity and slow queries.

Name: [Performance] Many-to-many relationships should be single-direction
Description: Prefer single-direction cross-filtering on many-to-many relationships unless bi-directional propagation is strictly required.

Name: [Performance] Set IsAvailableInMdx to false on hidden non-attribute columns
Description: Hidden columns not used in SortBy or hierarchies should set IsAvailableInMDX = false to reduce memory and processing time.
Expression: IsAvailableInMDX and (IsHidden or Table.IsHidden) and not UsedInSortBy.Any() and not UsedInHierarchies.Any() and not UsedInVariations.Any() and SortByColumn = null

Name: [Performance] Reduce calculated columns using RELATED
Description: Calculated columns using RELATED() can often be replaced by model relationships or Power Query merges at refresh time for better compression.

Name: [Performance] Reduce number of DAX calculated columns
Description: Excessive DAX calculated columns reduce VertiPaq compression and lengthen recalc times; move upstream transformations to Power Query or the data warehouse.

Name: [Performance] Avoid Double floating point data types
Description: Double columns can introduce rounding artifacts; use Int64 or Decimal (Fixed Decimal) where precision allows.

Name: [Formatting] Do not auto-summarize visible numeric columns
Description: Set SummarizeBy = None on visible numeric columns so report authors use explicit DAX measures instead of implicit aggregations.
Expression: (DataType = "Int64" or DataType = "Decimal" or DataType = "Double") and SummarizeBy <> "None" and not (IsHidden or Table.IsHidden)

Name: [Formatting] Hide foreign key columns
Description: Many-side relationship foreign keys should be hidden so authors slice via dimension tables.
Expression: UsedInRelationships.Any(FromColumn.Name == current.Name and FromCardinality == "Many") and IsHidden == false

Name: [DAX Expressions] Use DIVIDE() instead of / operator
Description: Use DIVIDE(numerator, denominator) to safely handle divide-by-zero cases.

Name: [DAX Expressions] Avoid IFERROR in DAX expressions
Description: IFERROR forces row-by-row error trapping and degrades performance; use DIVIDE() or explicit ISBLANK/type guards.

Name: [DAX Expressions] Avoid FILTER(Table, ...) inside CALCULATE
Description: Replace CALCULATE(..., FILTER('Table', 'Table'[Col] = ...)) with direct column predicates or KEEPFILTERS() to avoid scanning full tables.

Name: [DAX Expressions] Filter measure values by columns, not whole tables
Description: Use FILTER(VALUES('Table'[Col]), [Measure] > 0) instead of FILTER('Table', [Measure] > 0) inside CALCULATE.

Name: [DAX Expressions] Avoid duplicate measure definitions
Description: Two measures sharing identical normalized DAX expressions create maintenance ambiguity.

Name: [DAX Expressions] Measures should not simply alias another measure
Description: Remove redundant wrapper measures whose entire expression is just [OtherMeasure].

Name: [DAX Expressions] Inactive relationships never activated via USERELATIONSHIP
Description: Inactive relationships not referenced by USERELATIONSHIP in any measure or calculation item may be dead model metadata.
Expression: IsActive == false and not (Model.AllMeasures.Any(RegEx.IsMatch(Expression,"(?i)USERELATIONSHIP\s*\(\s*'*" + current.FromTable.Name + "'*\[" + current.FromColumn.Name + "\]\s*,\s*'*" + current.ToTable.Name + "'*\[" + current.ToColumn.Name + "\]")) or Model.AllCalculationItems.Any(RegEx.IsMatch(Expression,"(?i)USERELATIONSHIP\s*\(\s*'*" + current.FromTable.Name + "'*\[" + current.FromColumn.Name + "\]\s*,\s*'*" + current.ToTable.Name + "'*\[" + current.ToColumn.Name + "\]")))

Name: [Formatting] Provide format string for visible numeric measures
Description: Visible numeric measures should define a FormatString (excludes ImageUrl and pure string-literal title measures).
Expression: not IsHidden and not Table.IsHidden and string.IsNullOrWhitespace(FormatString) and DataCategory <> "ImageUrl" and not RegEx.IsMatch(Expression, "(?is)^\s*\x22")

Name: [Power Query] Avoid Table.NestedJoin in Power Query
Description: Table.NestedJoin is expensive in Power Query import models; prefer upstream database joins or semantic model relationships.

Name: [Power Query] Avoid Table.Join in Power Query
Description: Table.Join inside Power Query can break query folding and slow refreshes; push joins upstream where possible.

Name: [Power Query] Avoid fuzzy joins in Power Query
Description: Table.FuzzyJoin and Table.FuzzyNestedJoin are CPU-intensive and non-foldable.

Name: [Power Query] Review Table.Distinct in Power Query
Description: Table.Distinct can silently mask upstream duplicate key issues and hinder query folding.

Name: [Power Query] Review Table.RemoveDuplicates in Power Query
Description: Table.RemoveDuplicates in M may indicate uncleaned source keys or non-deterministic deduplication.

Name: [Power Query] Avoid hardcoded local file paths in M queries
Description: Hardcoded local drive or user-profile paths (C:\, D:\, Users\) break scheduled refreshes in Power BI Service / Fabric. Parameterize via SharePoint/OneLake/cloud connectors.

Name: [Metadata] Visible measures should have a description
Description: Add concise business descriptions to visible measures to improve maintainability and Copilot/Q&A accuracy.
Expression: not IsHidden and not Table.IsHidden and string.IsNullOrWhitespace(Description)

Name: [Metadata] Visible columns should have a description
Description: Document visible columns so report builders and Copilot understand field semantics.
Expression: not IsHidden and not Table.IsHidden and string.IsNullOrWhitespace(Description)

Name: [Metadata] Measures should be organized in Display Folders
Description: Assign DisplayFolder values to measures to keep large measure tables organized.

Name: [Metadata] Keep object descriptions concise (<= 200 chars)
Description: Descriptions longer than 200 characters risk truncation in tooltips and AI metadata context.
